name: Font override classes
summary: Use GOV.UK font override classes sparingly when content needs an explicit alignment, size, weight, number style or overflow treatment.
rules: Prefer the default typography of the component or content element before applying an override.
Use govuk-!-text-align-left, -right or -centre only when the content convention requires it.
Use reviewed govuk-!-font-size-* and govuk-!-font-weight-* classes instead of custom declarations.
Use tabular number and break-word overrides only for content that demonstrates the need.
accessibility: Visual alignment and weight do not change semantic reading order or importance.
Do not shrink essential information below standard body size.
When breaking long words or identifiers, confirm the full value remains available and understandable to assistive technology.
restrictions: Do not stack several override classes to redesign a component.
Do not use typography overrides as a substitute for the correct heading, paragraph or component class.
